enrichment.summary: The board ratifies the board president's appointment of one new member and the reappointment of another member, who will also serve as Chair, to the Measure N College and Career Readiness Commission. The terms run February 1, 2021 through January 31, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Appointment(s) - Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission - President, Board of Education

enrichment.headline: Hires ACC Environmental for $35,613 of hazardous materials checks at the Fremont High School project
enrichment.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc., the selected consultant, will do a limited hazardous materials investigation, a work plan, oversight and a final report for the Fremont High School new construction project. Work is scheduled from January 28, 2021 to January 27, 2022. It is paid from Measure J bond funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement - ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. - Fremont High School New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Hires Consolidated Engineering Laboratories for $28,666 of materials testing at The Center @ Foster
enrichment.summary: Consolidated Engineering Laboratories, the selected consultant, will provide materials testing and construction project services for the new greenhouse, tool shed, sink enclosure and canopy at The Center @ Foster. Work is scheduled from January 28, 2021 through December 31, 2021. It is paid from Measure J bond funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
